```artifact
Feature: System Availability and User Management

  Scenario: System Availability on Specified PinCodes
    Given the system is configured with the following PinCodes in the Parameter Control File
      | PinCode |
      | 1234    |
      | 5678    |
    When the system is accessed with a PinCode
    Then the system is available only for the specified PinCodes

  Scenario: User Login and Password Management
    Given the system is configured with user credentials
    When a user attempts to login with a valid username and password
    Then the system grants access to the user
    And the login-id/password is managed in a secured manner

  Scenario: Doctor-Specialty Mapping
    Given the system is configured with a Doctor and a Specialty
    When the Doctor is mapped to the Specialty
    Then the Doctor is linked to the Specialty
    And the Doctor is mapped to ONE and ONLY ONE Specialty

  Scenario: Doctor Consultation
    Given the system is configured with a Doctor and a Patient
    When the Doctor provides consultation to the Patient
    Then the Doctor is linked to the Patient
    And the Patient has a consultation request linked to the Doctor's Specialty

  Scenario: Patient Registration
    Given the system is configured with a Patient
    When the Patient registers themselves by filling the Patient profile
    Then a unique id is generated for the Patient
    And the Patient is registered in the system

  Scenario: Patient Consultation Request
    Given the system is configured with a Patient and a Doctor
    When the Patient requests consultation with the Doctor
    Then the Patient has a consultation request linked to the Doctor's Specialty

  Scenario Outline: System Availability on Invalid PinCodes
    Given the system is configured with the following PinCodes in the Parameter Control File
      | PinCode |
      | invalid_pin |
      | 12345    |
      | abcdef    |
    When the system is accessed with a PinCode
    Then the system is not available for the specified PinCodes

  Scenario Outline: User Login with Invalid Credentials
    Given the system is configured with user credentials
    When a user attempts to login with an invalid username and password
    Then the system denies access to the user

  Scenario Outline: Doctor-Specialty Mapping with Duplicate Mapping
    Given the system is configured with a Doctor and a Specialty
    When the Doctor is mapped to the Specialty with a duplicate mapping
    Then the system raises an error for duplicate mapping

  Scenario Outline: Patient Registration with Invalid Data
    Given the system is configured with a Patient
    When the Patient registers themselves with invalid data
    Then the system raises an error for invalid data
```
